messages:
Lena (marketing): Heads-up — we're aiming to announce the release next Tue. Need final changelog, docs links, bench narrative, and a webinar slot. Can we sync on canary timing and rollback plan?
Ajay (product): Sending the high-level launch brief in a sec. Main ask: make sure the changelog has the breaking-change callouts and the feature bullets for the blog.
Samir (eng): @Lena I can lock down canary windows. Preferred: canary starts Mon 18:00 PT, full rollout Tue 10:00 PT if metrics look good. Need CI-green + canary smoke tests to pass.
Noah (eng-lead): Agree w/ Samir. Also: set automatic fallback to 2.1-compat model if latency spikes. I'll add that to the rollout policy.
Ruth (docs): I'll publish the release notes and a short migration guide. Quick question — do we want a single docs page for "What's new" + migration, or split into two?
Lena (marketing): Single page is cleaner for the blog links. Can we include a short TL;DR with bullet points for the announcement?
Ruth (docs): Yup — I'll create a TL;DR section at the top and include a code example. Draft by Thu EOD.
Ajay (product): Benchmarks: marketing needs the 99th latency and cost-per-1M tokens numbers for the blog. @Samir can you confirm which run to use? Prefer the mixed-load run from last Friday (tag: bench/mixed-2024-07-12).
Samir (eng): Yep — that's the one. I'll paste the numbers here and push the perf graphs to the shared drive. Expected 99th p50 ~ 120ms and cost reduction ~22% vs baseline.
Lena (marketing): Webinar planning — we have a 45-min slot Wed next week at 10am PT. Who can present the technical demo? Need one ENG + one PM.
Noah (eng-lead): I can do the demo with Ajay. Samir can handle Q&A for deeper infra questions.
Ajay (product): I'll draft the slides and share tomorrow. Marketing — can you reserve the webinar page and capture registrations?
Lena (marketing): On it. Also need the docs link for the CTA in the webinar email. Ruth, can you give a publishing ETA?
Ruth (docs): Docs published and stable by Fri 17:00 PT. I'll provide the canonical URL then: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/release-notes/2024-07-release
Samir (eng): For rollout checklist, adding here so we don't forget:
```
- CI: all tests pass
- Canary: Mon 18:00 PT (10% traffic)
- Metrics: latency < 150ms (99th), error-rate < 0.5% over 15m
- Rollforward: increase to 50% after 1h if stable
- Full: Tue 10:00 PT if no regressions
- Fallback: route to 2.1-compat model on anomaly
```
Lena (marketing): Perfect. Can everyone react with :thumbsup: when the checklist is final? I'll coordinate the announcement copy once Ruth posts the docs and Samir confirms bench numbers.
Noah (eng-lead): :thumbsup:
Samir (eng): :thumbsup: I'll post the perf snippets by EOD Thu.
Ruth (docs): :thumbsup: publishing ETA confirmed Fri 17:00 PT.
deploy-bot: Deployment job queued for canary at 2024-07-15T18:00:00Z.
Lena (marketing): Thanks all — I'll assemble the announce draft and loop legal for the press snippet. If anything changes to timing, ping here immediately.
